subject: science
title: Light and Sound Lab · Q4 W08 D01
objective: Describe how light and sound behave and identify safe ways to protect people.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Light helps us see. Sound comes from vibrations and can travel to our ears. Very bright light and very loud sound can harm us, so use safe levels.

vocabulary.definition: what you hear when something vibrates
to move back and forth quickly

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use sound?
items.explanation: The answer is “use a quiet voice indoors.” It applies the safe and observable rule described in the lesson.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use light?

options.text: count the books on a shelf
use a lamp to read in a dark room
name a color in the room

items.explanation: The answer is “use a lamp to read in a dark room.” It applies the safe and observable rule described in the lesson.

items.prompt: Which example shows how sound behaves?

options.text: a drum makes sound when struck
a vibrating guitar string makes sound

items.explanation: The answer is “a bell rings when shaken.” It applies the safe and observable rule described in the lesson.

items.prompt: Which example shows how light behaves?

options.text: a lamp lights a dark room

items.explanation: The answer is “a mirror reflects light.” It applies the safe and observable rule described in the lesson.
